title: The Roof — EN/IT/PT (Pete McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 102bpm walking bass brushed drums English Italian Portuguese language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Pete was up before the birds
Hammer in his hand, didn't need the words
Twenty years of rooftops, rain or shine
Oldest son, he held the family line

[Verse 2 — Italiano]
Tegole e legno, caldo sulla schiena [Tiles and timber, heat on his back]
Non serviva un piano, conosceva la scena [Didn't need a plan, he knew the scene]
Ogni casa che ha toccato regge ancora in piedi [Every house he touched still stands]
Questo è il tipo d'uomo di cui la famiglia ha bisogno [That's the kind of man the family needs]

[Chorus — English]
From the roof he could see everything
The hills, the river, where the sea begins
And maybe that's the moment, maybe that's the call
When you've been that high, you don't stop at all

[Bridge — Português]
Do telhado ele via tudo que importava [From the roof he saw everything that mattered]
As colinas, o rio, o mar ao longe [The hills, the river, the sea in the distance]
Talvez seja esse o momento, talvez o chamado [Maybe that's the moment, maybe the call]
Quando você já esteve tão alto, não para [When you've been that high, you don't stop]

[Verse 3 — English]
Hung up the tool belt, walked toward the tide
Now he's on the water, boats and morning air
The roof is still there

[Outro — EN/IT/PT]
The roof is still there
Il tetto è ancora lì [The roof is still there]
O telhado ainda está lá [The roof is still there]
That's my boy
